# YouTube to Case Study

> A free, open-source Claude skill that turns any YouTube video into a case-study slideshow: a single self-contained HTML file (reveal.js) with speaker notes, PDF export, and every fact linked to the exact second in the video. Styles: business case study, marketing case study, UX / product case study, and growth teardown. Built for non-developers: marketers, educators, product managers, students, consultants.

## Install

- Claude Code (one step): `/plugin install youtube-to-case-study --marketplace tstfully/youtube-to-case-study`
- Claude Code (two steps): `/plugin marketplace add tstfully/youtube-to-case-study` then `/plugin install youtube-to-case-study@youtube-skills`
- Any agent via the Skills CLI: `npx skills add tstfully/youtube-to-case-study`
- Manual: clone into `~/.claude/skills/youtube-to-case-study`
- Claude.ai: download the repo ZIP and upload it under Settings → Capabilities → Skills

## How it works

1. Gets the video transcript from YouTubeTranscript.dev (MCP server, API key in `YOUTUBETRANSCRIPT_API_KEY`, or a transcript the user pastes from https://www.youtubetranscript.dev/tools/transcript).
2. Extracts the story: situation, complication, key moves, evidence with timestamps, results, lessons.
3. Picks a framework (business, marketing, UX, growth) and plans 10-16 slides.
4. Fills a pre-built template and returns one HTML file.

## Files

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the instructions an agent follows
- [references/case-study-frameworks.md](references/case-study-frameworks.md): story arcs per case-study style
- [references/slide-patterns.md](references/slide-patterns.md): HTML for every slide type
- [assets/template.html](assets/template.html): the slide template and design system
- [scripts/fetch-transcript.mjs](scripts/fetch-transcript.mjs): zero-dependency transcript fetcher (Node 18+)
- [examples/brewly-growth-teardown.html](examples/brewly-growth-teardown.html): finished example deck (fictional company)
